name: smwmusic-animal-crossing-new-leaf-bubblegum-k-k-aircheck
title: Animal Crossing: New Leaf - Bubblegum K.K. (Aircheck)
description:
The very cute and upbeat song Bubblegum K.K. from Animal Crossing New Leaf/New Horizons! Could be used as a generic athletic theme or maybe a title screen.

My very first port of a song I didn't write myself in a very long time! Didn't find a midi so I had to transcribe myself... so please credit me if you use this in your hack :)
